detection_confidence_status.enforcement_mechanism: Explicit webcam guard: detection_confidence < 0.50 triggers partial_face advisory and geometry masking.

preprocessing_sequence: 1. MediaPipe Face Landmarker (478 3D landmarks + 52 blendshapes + 4x4 matrix)
3. 5-point roll-based rigid rotation alignment (rigid Euclidean rotation to horizontal inter-ocular axis)
4. 1.30 margin crop around aligned face bounding box
7. 62-D geometry vector (52 blendshapes + 10 normalized distance ratios)
